# Elite FUT SNIPER

Elite FUT SNIPER is the world's most advanced web-app automation and sniping suite for EA Sports FC 26, FC 25, and FC 27 Ultimate Team.

## Core Features
- **Autobuyer & Sniping Bot:** Cloud-powered 20ms execution times to snipe players and SBC fodder instantly on the transfer market.
- **AI SBC Solver:** The ultimate SBC solution engine. Automatically detects the cheapest and best SBC solutions for any challenge and autofills your squad.
- **Anti-Ban Technology:** Employs randomized human-like delays, cooling breaks, and zero password sharing to guarantee a 100% ban-free experience.
- **Tax Calculator:** A real-time tool calculating the 5% EA transfer market tax, break-even prices, and profit margins.
